description: Test class for ConnectionFactoryImpl, verifying connection behaviors, timeouts, SSL configurations, and SASL mechanisms in the org.eclipse.hono.connection.impl package.

classes.name: ConnectionFactoryImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite verifying behaviors of ConnectionFactoryImpl, including connection success, failure, timeout handling, SSL/TLS configuration, and SASL mechanism settings.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test fixture with default ClientConfigProperties.

methods.name: testConnectInvokesHandlerOnFailureToConnect
methods.description: Ensures the connection attempt failure invokes the failure handler, confirming failure mode handling.

methods.name: testConnectInvokesHandlerOnConnectTimeout
methods.description: Checks that a connection timeout results in invoking the failure handler with ConnectTimeoutException.

methods.name: testConnectInvokesHandlerOnDisconnectAfterSendingOpenFrame
methods.description: Verifies that disconnects after sending open frame invoke callback failures, testing disconnect handling logic.

methods.name: testConnectDoesNotUseSaslPlainForEmptyUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Ensures SASL_PLAIN is not enabled when username and password are empty.

methods.name: testConnectAddsSaslPlainForNonEmptyUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Verifies that SASL_PLAIN mechanism is included when username and password are provided.

methods.name: testConnectEnablesSslIfExplicitlyConfigured
methods.description: Tests that SSL is enabled explicitly via configuration.

methods.name: testConnectEnablesSslIfTrustStoreIsConfigured
methods.description: Checks that SSL is enabled when trust store path is configured.
